form:FormGroup.label: Display Name
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Read only. Updated from the identity provider at sign-in.

form:HelpHTML.p: This is the display name for the user that will be used in most screens in Stroom and in audit log entries.
Stroom's property stroom.security.authentication.openId.userDisplayNameClaim determines which Open ID Connect claim is used to supply the Display Name.
It is read only here: it is obtained from the identity provider and updated each time the user signs in.

form:FormGroup.label: Full Name
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Read only. Updated from the identity provider at sign-in.

form:HelpHTML.p: The full name of the user, e.g. Joe Bloggs.
It is read only here: it is obtained from the identity provider and updated each time the user signs in.
This is the user's unique identifier on the external identity provider (e.g. Azure Entra ID, Cognito, Keycloak, etc.).
The identifier may be a UUID like b2cf3670-9d78-4bdf-9638-21f96b522b87, look like an email address or be something else. To find a user, look them up in the identity provider by this identifier.
Stroom's property stroom.security.authentication.openId.uniqueIdentityClaim determines which Open ID Connect claim is used for the unique identity.

form:FormGroup.label: Enabled
form:FormGroup.helpText: Untick to stop the user signing in. The change is saved immediately. Their permissions and content are kept.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Unticked users cannot sign in. Saved immediately.
